messages:
alex (CEO): All-hands today 4:00pm PT. Quick agenda: 1) Exec update 2) Dedicated GA timing 3) Policy: demo approvals & embargo 4) Incident summary + learnings 5) Q&A. Drop short questions here or add to Notion: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands. Recording after.

maya (VP Product): Please add one-line launch statuses under 'Launch Callouts' by 2pm. Two 3-min demo slots available.

nina (CTO): We'll show a 90s perf snapshot of the new kernel selector. If you have numbers, paste them in one line.

sam (People Ops): Reminder: leveling calibration invites went out. Referral bump effective next pay cycle. HR doc: https://hr.redwood/leveling.

ops-bot: All-hands reminder 4:00pm PT. Recording + transcript auto-uploaded after meeting.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1807600001. TL;DR: - Strategy: prioritize runtime SLOs and customer tooling. - Dedicated GA: targeting early Sep; pilots get migration help. - Policy: external demo approvals consolidated (Marketing + Legal sign-off). - Incident: autoscaler race postmortem published; mitigations in place. Follow-up doc + links to be posted Monday.

maya (VP Product): Action: publish onboarding checklist and launch playbook by Mon. Marketing will manage invites.

nina (CTO): Postmortem note: autoscaler race caused transient p99 spikes; fix deployed (cooldown and gating). Perf note to eng-notes.

sam (People Ops): FAQ: leveling does not retroactively change comp; referrals apply to FT conversions. Full FAQ in HR doc.

alex (CEO): Action items: 1) Product: GA playbook + checklist. 2) Eng: postmortem action tracker with owners/ETAs. 3) Marketing/Legal: finalize demo approval flow. Consolidated follow-up doc will be posted in Notion by Mon EOD. Thanks all. :rocket:
